_comment: History Content -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-12. Layout, numbering and spelling repairs; and, AT THE
PUBLISHER'S REQUEST (2026-10-12), new Key Competences descriptors where the manuscript's
repeated or belonged to the other year (see editCell `under`). No competence, activity
or expected standard in the matrix is rewritten.
MATRIX NUMBERS. In Year 1 the topic and most sub-topic cells carry no number, and the
competence numbers are Word list numbers that run on across topics (1.1.1.4, 1.1.1.5
... 1.1.1.11 under Missionary Activities, Imperialism, Colonial Rule, the First World War
and World Peace; one more, 1.1.1.12, printed in the Expected Standard column in Year 2).
Year 2 numbers topic 2.1's sub-topics 2.1.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.3, 2.2.4. renumberMatrix counts
them all afresh from the table's structure. The result agrees with the manuscript's own
typed contents list (1.1 Concept of History, 1.4 The Origins of Man, 1.13.2 African
reaction to colonial rule ...).
KEY COMPETENCES DESCRIPTORS (publisher's request, 2026-10-12). Year 1: three rows
repeated another row's descriptor (Emotional Intelligence = Citizenship; Financial
Education = Entrepreneurship; Problem Solving = Environmental Sustainability); each now
takes a Year 1 competence of its own from the matrix. Year 2: every descriptor was
repeated or drawn from Year 1 (federation, missionaries, Black Friday, colonial
governance) or from the Industrial Revolution, which is in neither year; all twelve are
replaced with descriptors drawn from the Year 2 topics (Second World War, United
Nations, Cold War, liberation struggle, Pan-Africanism, African Union) -- matrix
competence wording where one fits. The new wording should be confirmed by CDC.
DIRECTOR'S NAME: 'Charles Makala (Dr.)' in this manuscript; set as 'Charles Ndakala
(Dr.)', as in the Music Content and Music Methods syllabuses (publisher's decision).
ISBN: none given; the imprint shows a blank ISBN line (publisher's decision).
2026-10-23 proofread round 1 (reviewer's PDF from the Mailo folder, '... - typeset.pdf';
its copies (1) are the same file): 18 comments, all made -- see the PROOFREAD rules in
`edit`, `cellSubtext` and `editCell`. Page numbers in the rules are the reviewer's PDF's.
